name: arrow
description: Draws straight arrows with solid, open or hollow heads, single or double-ended; hold Shift to snap to 45 degrees.

descriptionLocalized.zh-Hant: 畫直線箭頭，箭頭可選實心、開口或空心；按住 Shift 以 45° 對齊。
descriptionLocalized.zh-Hans: 画直线箭头，箭头可选实心、开口或空心；按住 Shift 以 45° 对齐。

screenshots.alt: An arrow points at the Publish button on a documentation page.
Arrows are dragged onto a page, one snaps to 45° with Shift, and the panel switches to a hollow, dashed, double-headed style.
